header.description: What precedes the pack in the body, on a line of its own.

name.description: The repository's name: its dev.knotless.repo record key.

main.description: The body is one line of JSON, a #header, then a git packfile holding every object the updates need that the repository lacks (empty when every update is a deletion). Each update succeeds or fails on its own.

error.description: Why the update was refused; absent when it landed.

dst.description: The full ref name, such as refs/heads/main.

force.description: Move it even when the move is not a fast-forward.

src.description: The hex object ID to point it at; absent to delete the ref.

description: Pushes to a repository through a gateway its owner has delegated writes to: the gateway checks the caller is the owner or a collaborator, then writes the pack and ref updates as the owner. Requires a service token from the caller's PDS, audience the gateway's DID, for this method.
